title: form_draft.js script-tag inclusion is pinned only on the resume render — pristine and error re-render load it unpinned
evidence: form_view.gleam:109 (pristine view_form): `        view_draft_saver_script(),` — form_pages.gleam:370 (view_form_with_errors): `        form_view.view_draft_saver_script(),` — the only pins anywhere are resume-page tests: form_pages_test.gleam:334 `  html |> string.contains("form_draft.js") |> should.be_true` (inside resume_page_has_resume_marker_banner_and_no_error_banner_test) and draft_integration_test.gleam:307 (resume render). every_form_render_path_loads_consent_script_test covers consent.js across render paths but not form_draft.js.
detail: Deleting the script tag from the pristine or error assembly silently kills the entire save-and-resume feature on its primary surface; all 97 JS tests and every server test stay green (JS tests import the module directly).
recommended_fix: Extend the every-render-path pattern: assert form_draft.js (and shouldActivate's markers) in pristine view_form and view_form_with_errors tests, mirroring the existing resume-page pin.

title: Stepper resume-start wiring unpinned: the form-resume → firstIncompleteIndex ternary lives in unexported initBrowser
detail: The acceptance criterion 'stepper starts at first incomplete section' has its pure logic pinned but the one-line wiring connecting the form-resume marker to it is not; reverting the ternary to 0 regresses resume UX with zero test failures.
recommended_fix: Export an _initBrowser(env) seam like form_draft.js's and drive a form-resume render through it asserting the model starts at the first incomplete section.

title: B1 fix unpinned: no test asserts continue-link emailed URLs are built from vacancy.origin_domain, never the request origin
evidence:
draft_handler.gleam:327-332: `                      let base =
                        email_client.build_entity_url(
                          origin_domain: vacancy.origin_domain,
                          path: "/apply/" <> vacancy.short_code,
                        )` — grep of server/test/ for origin_domain finds only test/vacancy/origin_domain_test.gleam (domain_helpers validation) and test_helpers.gleam:21; nothing exercises the handler's URL-base selection (the send path is never automated, and the base choice is not separately observable).
detail: Reverting this line to canonical_origin(req) re-opens the X-Forwarded-Host token-exfiltration hole while compiling cleanly and passing the full suite; the security-critical decision in the new fix code has no regression fence.
recommended_fix: Extract the base-URL decision into a pure function over the vacancy row (unit-test origin_domain used, request origin ignored) or add a sender-injection seam to capture the URL in a handler test.

title: claim_continue_link_send submitted_at/erased_at guard arms unpinned — continue-link after submit or erasure never exercised
evidence:
claim_continue_link_send.sql: `WHERE vacancy_id = $1::uuid
  AND email = lower($2)
  AND submitted_at IS NULL
  AND erased_at IS NULL` — draft_integration_test.gleam pins the cooldown arm (claim_continue_link_send_mints_once_then_cools_down_test, continue_link_on_cooldown_answers_uniform_200_without_send_test), the window (cooldown_window_is_ten_minutes_test) and fan-out (fan_out_bound_end_to_end_test), but no test claims against a submitted or erased draft, and no handler-level test POSTs continue-link for an erased pair asserting uniform 200/sent:false without resurrection.
detail: The tombstone story is otherwise well fenced (upsert guard, list filter, erasure replay); these two claim arms are the remaining untested boundary — a dropped guard would email a live link for an erased draft with no failing test.
recommended_fix: Add two small integration cases: claim on a stripped draft and on an erased draft both return zero rows; optionally the handler-level continue-link-after-erasure 200/sent:false case.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 coverage 100% (save/resume/strip/erasure/expiry/cascade, draft cap, fan-out, cooldown, no-leak 404s, field-filter contract, client wiring — all pinned; 97/97 JS tests verified passing locally).
